thread:
marta: FYI - new user hit a paywall during onboarding. They clicked the invite link and got a 'Payment required' page before making their first API call.
ben: that's surprising, invite flow should create a trial org. do we know if they joined an existing org?
ellie: any chance this was SSO or enterprise invite? those sometimes require billing checks up front.
marta: personal gmail, not SSO. user pasted curl and we saw 402 on the very first request:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{"error":"workspace requires billing setup"}
```
ryan: hmm. the quickstart path should treat invites created by the signup flow as auto-trial. maybe a race between invite accept and billing record creation.
ben: do we have the invite id or org id?
marta: invite id is abc123 (from the invite link). user said they got redirected to billing with that token in the URL.
samir: quick workaround: ask user to go to https://app.redwood.ai/billing and click "Start trial" - that unblocks the first call. did that work?
marta: sent the link, user clicked start trial, retried the same curl and got 200. confirmed first call succeeded. :tada:
payments-bot: Created support ticket PAY-4321 for invite abc123, assigned to billing team.
ellie: we should update invite email / onboarding banner to include the billing CTA - people miss it and think they can't use the quickstart.
ben: long-term fix: add guard in onboarding service to default invites from signup pipeline to soft-trial state until we verify usage>0. prevents preflight billing check on first API call.
ryan: i'll file an engineering task and link PAY-4321. moving to onboarding backlog, priority P2.
marta: thanks - closing the thread since user is unblocked. :raised_hands:
